pivots.pgt_chuck: spins about its local Z (the chuck axis)
pivots.pgt_trigger: rotates about its local X; squeeze = rotation.x of about -0.2 rad (blade moves toward the grip)

notes: origin = centre of the grip; +Z = chuck direction (away from the user); +Y up. pgt_body = Tripo mesh (pgt_body_mat, 4096) + modelled D-ring (pgt_parts_mat). em_pgt_status = alpha-blended emissive copies of the faces carrying the cyan segments (side panels, rear cap, battery); the body texture underneath is darkened so 'off' reads dark.
